text:
ITEM 1 | Leafy green greens, dark green curly-edged leaves with lighter green stems and ribs, mixed with thin orange shredded strips (carrot-like julienne) and small dark brown/black shreds, lightly glossy with dressing, piled loosely on the left side of a white square plate, spanning about 13 x 12 cm with a height of roughly 3 cm | 60

ITEM 2 | Cauliflower florets, pale creamy white to light yellow-green, bumpy clustered surface with soft, slightly moist texture, holding their shape, three to four florets each about 4-5 cm across, sitting at the upper right of the plate next to the greens | 110

ITEM 3 | Scattered small orange shreds and a few dark brown specks lying on the plate surface around the greens and cauliflower, thin and dry-looking, under 1 cm each | 3
